svg.desc: 67 open-source agent skills for Claude Code, Codex, Hermes and MCP clients across 6 specialties. Install with /plugin marketplace add JasonColapietro/suede-creator-skills, then /plugin install suede-skills@suede.
svg.text: Open-source skills for SEO, copy, growth, code review and app delivery.
Readable instructions, one install, evidence in every output.
